title.zh: 【ESMA 就代币化抵押品用于中央清算征求行业意见】
title.en: 【ESMA 就代币化抵押品用于中央清算征求行业意见】

current_state.zh: ESMA launched an industry consultation on the legal, liquidity and operational risks of using tokenized collateral in central clearing, including whether tokenized representations confer enforceable ownership rights and how such assets interact with stablecoins, central bank money and tokenized deposits.
current_state.en: ESMA launched an industry consultation on the legal, liquidity and operational risks of using tokenized collateral in central clearing, including whether tokenized representations confer enforceable ownership rights and how such assets interact with stablecoins, central bank money and tokenized deposits.
